record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly reduce learning rate from 7e-4 to 5e-4 and increase dropout from 0.1 to 0.15. Smaller updates and moderately stronger regularization may stabilize the newly unconstrained mask embedding and improve generalization. Retain MAXLEN=128, batch size 128, width 64, existing features, embedding parameterization, topology, readout and loss; keep seed 42 and the 200-epoch/200-batch limits.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four category models, jointly lower learning rate to 5e-4 and raise dropout to 0.15. Smaller updates and stronger regularization may stabilize the newly unconstrained mask embedding. This configuration previously regressed with the earlier embedding parameterization, so its benefit remains uncertain. Preserve dimensions, history length, batch size, backbone, loss and training limits. Existing metadata and predictor loading remain compatible.
